question: Must ritual faults involving breakage, improper giving, or contact be addressed by the priests?
premises: Breakage and similar defects may occur
inference: These faults require attention from the best twice-born priests
uncertainties: pṛṣṭe may mean asked or touched depending on context
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, when there is breakage and the like, or when it is given or touched.
